title: Sleep and Cardiovascular Risk
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to sleep and cardiovascular risk.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the association of poor sleep quality and obstructive sleep apnea with increased cardiovascular risk. Evidence linking sleep duration with cardiovascular outcomes is supported by meta-analyses, while interventional data on the impact of sleep improvement on major cardiovascular endpoints remain emerging. Safety considerations for device use and medication therapies are well-documented but require individualized clinical evaluation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
